query.gold_reference_answer: Yes. This group of elderly stroke patients were able to record their BPs reliably at home. Any bias was small and would be unlikely to affect management. Since BP readings in a GP surgery are often a poor indication of true BP, GPs might consider using hypertensive patients' records of home BP monitoring to help guide treatment decisions.
query.question: Are stroke patients' reports of home blood pressure readings reliable?
